description: Defines the enum class dc_offset_t and helper functions for handling DC offset in OFDM subcarriers, including packing and containment checks, related to 3GPP TS 38.331 specifications.

classes.name: dc_offset_t
classes.description: Enumeration representing DC offset positions relative to subcarriers, including min, center, max, outside, and undetermined states.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Packs a dc_offset_t value into a 16-bit unsigned integer for message transmission, considering spectrum boundaries.

methods.name: is_contained
methods.description: Checks if a given DC offset or position is within a specified resource block interval.
